name: Requiem Of An Edginess
source:
Mel works as a drug dealer, and one day she meets Seth. He starts buying drugs from her and they slowly start getting along. 

After some time they end up falling in love and losing their minds together.

Do you want to see how and why?

[From [url=https://rin-fla.itch.io/requiem-of-an-edginess]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅尔是一名毒贩，某天她结识了塞斯。塞斯开始向她买药，两人的关系也一点点熟络起来。

一段时间过后，他们双双坠入爱河，并一同陷入疯狂。

你想亲眼看看这一切究竟是如何发生、又因何而起的吗？

[摘自[url=https://rin-fla.itch.io/requiem-of-an-edginess]itch.io[/url]]
